versions.short: The law extends two federal tax benefits tied to disasters. It keeps in place the deduction for unreimbursed personal property losses from declared major disasters, now covering disasters whose incident period starts on or after December 28, 2019 and before January 1, 2027. It also extends the rule that excludes from taxable income certain wildfire relief payments tied to federally declared forest or range fires after 2014 and before 2027, no matter when those payments are received.
